package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"

// scenario for init_registers_routes_or_dependencies: `init()` functions that register handlers, routes, or runtime dependencies.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

var globalRouter = mux.NewRouter()

func init() {
	globalRouter.HandleFunc("/api/v1/users", listUsers).Methods("GET")
	globalRouter.HandleFunc("/api/v1/users/{id}", getUser).Methods("GET")
	globalRouter.HandleFunc("/api/v1/orders", listOrders).Methods("GET")
}

func listUsers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)   {}
func getUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)     {}
